Anything about the tree, the patio plans, or anything else I should know?

transcript.text: Maya, I actually consulted an arborist about the pear tree. They inspected it and said it's healthy, but it must remain in place -- no digging or trenching within 12 feet of the trunk. They also recommended light pruning after the harvest. That's going to be important for the patio plans.

transcript.text: Maya, I also looked into something that might matter for this. I spoke with the coordinator at the nearby food pantry, and they said the pantry can accept our pears, but only if they're delivered on Thursdays, in reusable crates, with no more than 4 crates per week. I haven't had a chance to bring this to the group until now, but since we produce more pears than we usually use in late summer, this could be a good option for the surplus if we keep the tree.
